text:
Maria CS: Heads up — Moonbeam dedicated pool bring-up tomorrow 08:00 PT. Final checklist and quick sync here.
Lin SE: On it. Quick status: quota requested = 12 GPUs / 96 vCPUs, committed throughput target = 150 rps sustained, 450 burst. Is that still correct?
Tom (Moonbeam PM): Yep — validated with their infra team. Main concern is ingestion bursts from batch jobs at 03:00 UTC that spike to ~4x baseline.
Ajay SRE: For autoscale policy I propose: base=6 GPUs, scale_step=2, cooldown=120s, max=12. Use token-based throttles on the endpoint to cap per-API-key QPS during spikes.
Maria CS: Sounds good. Ben, any billing implications if they hit sustained bursts above committed? Need to flag renewal risk if costs balloon.
Ben Billing: They'll have committed capacity contract. Overages bill at 1.6x list. I'll add a clause to the invoice draft and send Tom a copy. Also flagging that we may need pre-approval for >10% monthly overage.
Zoe Ops: Who is on call for the warmup load window? We should have someone on SRE + SE for the 08:00-10:00 PT window and Night Ops for the 03:00 UTC batch.
Ajay SRE: I can cover the morning warmup. @Zoe Ops can you assign Night Ops?
Zoe Ops: Assigning @Nadia NightOps for the 03:00 UTC window. She'll join the shadow channel.
Lin SE: Load test plan draft: 1) prefix-priming with 30m steady at 150 rps 2) step to 450 rps for 20m 3) simulated KV cache cold start: restart pool, run 10m ramp 4) chaos: drop one GPU mid-step.
Maria CS: Perfect. Add these commands to run the k6 harness in case we need to replay locally.
Lin SE: Adding now — snippet:
```
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 30m load/moonbeam_prefix.js 
# step to stress
k6 run --vus 500 --duration 20m load/moonbeam_spike.js
```
Lin SE: We'll also push a small script to the ops repo to rotate the model variants and test fallback.
Tom (Moonbeam PM): Timeline: warmup at 08:00 PT tomorrow, smoke at 09:00 PT, traffic shift to dedicated at 09:30 PT. Customer-side contact: @sara_moonbeam (will be in the channel).
Maria CS: Can someone drop the endpoint and API key we should use for the harness?
Lin SE: Endpoint: https://api.redwood-prod.example/models/moonbeam-dedicated/generate
API key: redacted (we'll PM Tom and Sara with the key).
Ajay SRE: Runbook checklist:
- confirm dedicated pool healthy (node status = Ready)
- run prefix priming script
- verify latency p50/p99 within SLOs
- monitor KV cache hit rate > 80% after priming
- watch for error spike > 1% -> rollback to shared model
Zoe Ops: I'll paste the runbook into the #runbooks channel and create the incident channel: #moonbeam-dedicated-bringup.
deploy-bot: deploy job moonbeam-warmup v2 started by Lin SE — build 78 -> staging -> dedicated.
Maria CS: One more ask: capture customer feedback during the smoke — Tom, please ask them these 3 quick questions: 1) any quality regressions vs shared model? 2) acceptable latency at 95th percentile? 3) cost sensitivity for this phase. I'll add to the post-run survey.
Tom (Moonbeam PM): Will do. I'll be in the channel and will ping results.
Ben Billing: I'll join 09:00 PT to confirm metering and set up an overage alert threshold in billing console.
Ajay SRE: If we see KV cold-start impact, plan B is auto-warm cache via short-lived synthetic prompts at 5s TTL until priming completes.
Maria CS: Great. Anyone have objections to the autoscale params? If not, I'll mark this as approved and send the final invite. :thumbsup:
Lin SE: Approved.
Ajay SRE: Approved.
Zoe Ops: All set from Ops.
Tom (Moonbeam PM): Approved from Moonbeam side. Sara will standby.
Maria CS: Thanks team — sending calendar invite and the timeline now. I'll post post-run notes in this thread after the smoke. :party:
